g.text: The MAGE Dynamic Model — one system, four dynamics
[B] balancing — loops [2]+[3] seek fit, damping churn (goal-seeking). · [R] reinforcing — loop [4] reopens the frontier. · Loop [1] bootstrap is an input, not a feedback loop.

text.tspan: represent · constrain · validate · strengthen · reconcile · retire
changes the shape of future work

g.text: 1 Bootstrap (input) — prior knowledge seeds the environment
2 Pressure / discovery — pressure reveals missing structure
4 Capability-amplification — a stronger environment enlarges ambition
